Zavod za zdravstveno zavarovanje Slovenije (v nadaljnjem besedilu: ZZZS) v opredeljenem okolju opravlja funkcijo nosilca in izvajalca obveznega zdravstvenega zavarovanja (v nadaljnjem besedilu: OZZ) ter je z julijem 2025 prevzel tudi zbiranje prispevkov in financiranje pravic iz dolgotrajne oskrbe (v nadaljnjem besedilu: DO). ZZZS vodi obvezno zavarovanje za DO in iz zbranih prispevkov ter državnih sredstev plačuje storitve. Zakon o dolgotrajni oskrbi ureja oskrbo oseb, ki so zaradi bolezni, invalidnosti ali starostne oslabelosti dalj časa odvisne od pomoči pri osnovnih in vsakodnevnih opravilih. Njegov cilj je omogočiti uporabnikom, da čim dlje ostanejo v domačem okolju, hkrati pa vsem zagotavlja dostop do institucionalnega varstva. Približno desetina slovenskega bruto domačega proizvoda se vsako leto prek ZZZS usmeri v sistem zdravstvenih storitev in razdeli med več kot 1.600 izvajalcev za potrebe 2,1 milijona zavarovancev. Glavnino prihodkov predstavljajo prispevki zaposlenih oseb in delodajalcev, dopolnjujejo pa jih tudi transferji iz državnega proračuna, katerih delež narašča. Statement of Work paragraph 2.1 requires documented evidence of past performance migrating legacy Microsoft Access systems to Microsoft 365 and the Power Platform. Two questions on this paragraph: a. Is 2.1 a pass or fail responsibility requirement, or is it evaluated as part of the past performance factor described in the evaluation criteria? b. Where an offeror's relevant past performance was performed under commercial contracts rather than federal prime contracts, will the Government accept that commercial past performance? Will the Government also accept the relevant past performance of proposed key personnel or of a proposed subcontractor? Answer: Paragraph 2.1 is evaluated as part of the Government’s technical assessment of the offeror’s relevant past performance and technical competency, rather than as a separate pass/fail responsibility determination. The Government will accept relevant commercial past performance, not just federal prime contract experience, provided the quoted experience demonstrates comparable scope, complexity, and relevance to the requirement. The Government may also consider relevant experience of proposed key personnel and proposed subcontractors, to the extent the quote clearly identifies the experience, exp

any required interim milestones or target dates within the 180-calendar-day period for architecture/design approval, development, UAT, production migration, and final handoff? Answer: Timeline requirements for individual deliverables/CLINs are amended as follows: Deliverable D.1 required within 45 days of contract award. Deliverables D.2 through D.8 required within 160 days of contract award. Deliverables D.9 through D.10 required within 180 days of contract award. 63. Section G requires certification documentation for Microsoft 365 and SharePoint Online. May the offeror satisfy this requirement with certifications held by named key personnel who will perform the work, or must the certifications be held at the offeror entity level? Answer: The Government will accept certifications held by the individual personnel proposed to perform the work. An organizational-level Microsoft designation or partner status is not required to satisfy this certification requirement. 64. Will the contractor receive a dedicated development/sandbox site collection or Power Platform environment within the Government’s Flank Speed tenant before detailed design (D.1), or is all build work to occur in a contractor-owned tenant with export/import packaging for Government deployment? If teaming is permissible, please also advise whether there is a preferred format for identifying each team member's qualifications, roles, and past performance within the quotation. This capability must allow operators to identify and prioritize interoperability issues and potential workarounds within a single system. • 3.1.3.2 Platform Issue Tracking: The software shall provide a mechanism to record and maintain a history of platform-specific issues (e.g., design, testing, operational) through their entire lifecycle. This information must be linked to the platform specification to enable automatic updates to existing analyses. • 3.1.3.3 Capabilities & Limitations Summary: The software shall be capable of generating a consolidated, high-level summary of a platform's TDL capabilities, including implemented TDLs, message baselines, equipment fits, and network capabilities (e.g., Link 22, JREAP). 3.1.4 Interoperability (IO) Evaluation: The software shall provide a robust module to conduct detailed, multi-platform IO evaluations. PURPOSE: • Provide a FedRAMP Moderate or High authorized cloud electronic fax solution • Ensure full integration with Microsoft Teams (native or API-based) • Maintain HIPAA-compliant transmission and storage of PHI • Ensure Government ownership and portability of all fax DIDs • Enable secure, auditable, and reliable fax communications across IHS • Eliminate on-premises fax infrastructure (cloud-only solution) • Provide high availability and continuity of operations SCOPE OF WORK: The contractor shall provide all labor, materials, software, licenses, cloud services, and support necessary to deliver a fully managed, cloud-native electronic fax solution. Consistent with the sample fax PWS, the contractor shall provide a secure web-based faxing capability with audit logging, encryption, and technical support. PERIOD OF PERFORMANCE: The anticipated period of performance includes one (1) 12-month base period and four (4) 12-month option periods. The base period is September 30, 2026, through September 29, 2027. Each option period, if exercised, will continue for 12 months following the prior performance period.

= FILE: files/7571TE-26CSS-1527532-PWS.pdf ===== PERFORMANCE WORK STATEMENT (PWS) - FedRAMP-Compliant Cloud Electronic Fax Solution Integrated with Microsoft Teams 1.0 INTRODUCTION The mission of the Indian Health Service (IHS) is to raise the physical, mental, social, and spiritual health of American Indians and Alaska Natives to the highest level. To support this mission, IHS requires a secure, cloud-based electronic fax solution that ensures the protection of Protected Health Information (PHI), enhances clinical and administrative workflows, and integrates seamlessly with enterprise collaboration platforms. The work will start with approximately ¼ of the agency, starting with the Great Plains Area, Billings Area and Oklahoma Areas. Lisa jõustub pärast selle allkirjastamist mõlema poole poolt. Lisa rakendatakse, kui volitatud töötleja töötleb vastutava töötleja nimel vastavalt lepingule andmesubjekti isikuandmeid. Käesolev lisa kujutab endast isikuandmete töötlemist puudutavat andmetöötlus lepingut vastavalt Euroopa Liidu isikuandmete kaitse üldmäärusele (2016/679) (edaspidi: GDPR). Andmesubjektide kategooriad ja isikuandmete liigid, mida teenuse osutamisel töödeldakse, isikuandmete töötlemise kestus, iseloom ja eesmärgid ning vastutava töötleja poolt antud juhised on välja toodud igas lepingus ja selle lisades, mh andmetöötluse lepingus. Leping puudutab isikuandmete töötlemist volitatud töötleja poolt kuni teenuse osutamise lõpuni.
